negative_proof.test: refresh reserves its request before abort so the newer callback read wins
negative_proof.method: Copied exact base projection and new test into an isolated temporary module; no source mutation or live adapter. Bounded subprocess timeout was 20 seconds.
negative_proof.assertion: superseded outer refresh must not invoke the adapter

cases: Newer refresh started by read abort wins; superseded outer read never invokes the adapter.
Read abort selection or disposal prevents further old adapter invocation.
Selection publishes new identity before read/view abort and preserves newer resources.
Dispose publishes terminal state before callbacks; active local handle closes once.
Merge abort/close callbacks cannot restore ready over a new selection or disposal.
Refresh rechecks its fence after merge cleanup starts a newer read.
Nested synchronous passive cleanup excludes new passive admission until cleanup returns.
Late stale handle close uses the same synchronous admission guard.
